semantics.left_middle: Smart-light channels. Physical mains remain continuously energized; button actions update local logical state and send explicit bound On/Off matching that state. LED follows locally tracked binding intent.
semantics.right: Pure local relay channel. Button updates RIGHT logical state; RIGHT physical mains follows that state; LED follows physical output. Direct-bound/group command transmission is disabled without deleting binding topology.
semantics.ha_reconciliation: LEFT and MIDDLE only. RIGHT is excluded from downstream-light corrective synchronization.
